title: Company
subtitle: Company details, departments and business hours.

info.title: Company details
info.inactiveBanner: This company is deactivated. Members cannot access its data and connections stay paused until it is reactivated.
info.name: Company name
info.timeZoneLocked: Only owners and administrators can change the time zone.
info.statusEmailsHint: Sends an e-mail when a WhatsApp connection goes down or comes back.
info.readOnly: You don't have permission to edit the company details.
info.slugInvalid: Use 2 to 63 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.

deactivate.title: Deactivate company?
deactivate.body: The company "{name}" will be deactivated. This is what happens:

effects.access: Members lose access to the company data (chats, contacts, pipeline and reports).
effects.connections: WhatsApp connections are paused and stop sending and receiving messages.
effects.automations: Flows, dispatches and automations stop running.
effects.reactivate: The owner can reactivate the company later on this same screen.

reactivate.title: Activate company
reactivate.body: The company "{name}" goes back to normal. Paused connections must be resumed in Connections.
